summary: BeyondSpring Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a September 28, 2026 Share Purchase and Collaboration Agreement with Dalian Wanchunbulin Pharmaceuticals Ltd. (Bulin) and Biolin Investment Limited (Investor) to sell all shares of BeyondSpring Ltd., a BVI subsidiary indirectly holding Bulin. No cash consideration is paid; the Investor's non-cash consideration is conducting and completing the China portion of the DUBLIN-4 Phase 3 trial of Plinabulin plus docetaxel in advanced non-squamous NSCLC. Bulin must use commercially reasonable efforts to meet a Company-determined Target Enrollment over three years post-Closing. Failure triggers pro-rata Equity Interest transfer back. Watch enrollment risk and potential reversal mechanics.
